def _make_slider(self, label, var_list, from_, to):
        frame = tk.Frame(self.root, bg="#1e1e2f")
        tk.Label(frame, text=label, bg="#1e1e2f", fg="white").pack(side="left")
        s1 = tk.Scale(frame, variable=var_list[0], from_=from_, to=to, orient="horizontal", resolution=0.01, length=200, bg="#1e1e2f", fg="white")
        s2 = tk.Scale(frame, variable=var_list[1], from_=from_, to=to, orient="horizontal", resolution=0.01, length=200, bg="#1e1e2f", fg="white")
        s1.pack()
        s2.pack()
        frame.pack()
    def _build_gui(self):
        self.genre_checkbuttons = {}  # Initialize dictionary to store genre buttons

        tk.Frame(self.root, bg="#1e1e2f").pack()
        tk.Label(self.root, text="Heaven's Rave", font=("Arial", 24), bg="#1e1e2f", fg="white").pack()
        tk.Label(self.root, text="Select your filters:", font=("Arial", 16), bg="#1e1e2f", fg="white").pack()
        tk.Label(self.root, text="Heaven's Rave Config", font=("Arial", 18), bg="#1e1e2f", fg="white").pack()
        tk.Label(self.root, text="Playlist Name:", bg="#1e1e2f", fg="white").pack()
        tk.Label(self.root, text="Select Genres:", bg="#1e1e2f", fg="white").pack()
        self._make_slider("Energy", self.energy_range, 0.0, 1.0)
        self._make_slider("Valence", self.valence_range, 0.0, 1.0)
        self._make_slider("Tempo", self.tempo_range, 60, 200)
        genre_frame = tk.Frame(self.root, bg="#1e1e2f")
        tk.Button(genre_frame, text="Summon Playlist", command=self.summon_playlist, bg="#7d2ae8", fg="white").pack(side="top")
        tk.Button(genre_frame, text="Clear Spotify Cache", command=self.clear_spotify_cache, bg="#e8742a", fg="white").pack(side="top")
        tk.Button(genre_frame, text="Select All", command=self.select_all_genres, bg="#7d2ae8", fg="white").pack(side="left")
        tk.Button(genre_frame, text="Deselect All", command=self.deselect_all_genres, bg="#7d2ae8", fg="white").pack(side="right")
        for genre in self.available_genres:
            btn = tk.Checkbutton(
                genre_frame,
                text=genre.title(),
                variable=self.selected_genres[genre],
                bg="#1e1e2f",
                fg="white",
                selectcolor="#7d2ae8",
                command=lambda g=genre: self.genre_clicked(g)
            )
            btn.pack(side="left")
            self.genre_checkbuttons[genre] = btn
        # AI Search section
        ai_frame = tk.Frame(self.root, bg="#1e1e2f")
        ai_frame.pack(pady=10)
        tk.Label(ai_frame, text="🤖 AI Music Search:", font=("Arial", 14), bg="#1e1e2f", fg="white").pack()
        
        search_input_frame = tk.Frame(ai_frame, bg="#1e1e2f")
        search_input_frame.pack(pady=5)
        tk.Label(search_input_frame, text="Query:", bg="#1e1e2f", fg="white").pack(side="left")
        self.ai_search_entry = tk.Entry(search_input_frame, width=50)
        self.ai_search_entry.pack(side="left", padx=5)
        tk.Button(search_input_frame, text="AI Search", command=self.ai_search_playlist, bg="#2ae84a", fg="white").pack(side="left")
        
        # Search type options
        search_type_frame = tk.Frame(ai_frame, bg="#1e1e2f")
        search_type_frame.pack(pady=5)
        tk.Label(search_type_frame, text="Search type:", bg="#1e1e2f", fg="white").pack(side="left")
        
        self.search_type = tk.StringVar(value="smart")
        tk.Radiobutton(search_type_frame, text="Smart Search", variable=self.search_type, value="smart", bg="#1e1e2f", fg="white", selectcolor="#7d2ae8").pack(side="left")
        tk.Radiobutton(search_type_frame, text="Lyrics Search", variable=self.search_type, value="lyrics", bg="#1e1e2f", fg="white", selectcolor="#7d2ae8").pack(side="left")
        tk.Radiobutton(search_type_frame, text="My Playlists", variable=self.search_type, value="playlists", bg="#1e1e2f", fg="white", selectcolor="#7d2ae8").pack(side="left")
        
        # AI result display
        self.ai_result_text = tk.StringVar(value="AI search results will appear here...")
        tk.Label(ai_frame, textvariable=self.ai_result_text, bg="#1e1e2f", fg="#cccccc", wraplength=600, justify="left").pack(pady=5)

        # Add this to the _build_gui method, after the other buttons
        debug_frame = tk.Frame(self.root, bg="#1e1e2f")
        debug_frame.pack(pady=10)
        tk.Label(debug_frame, text="Debug Track ID:", bg="#1e1e2f", fg="white").pack(side="left")
        self.debug_track_entry = tk.Entry(debug_frame, width=30)
        self.debug_track_entry.pack(side="left", padx=5)
        tk.Button(debug_frame, text="Test Genre Match", command=self.test_genre_match, bg="#7d2ae8", fg="white").pack(side="left")
        default_name = "Heaven's Rave"
        playlist_name = self.config.get("playlist_name", default_name) if self.config else default_name
        self.playlist_name_entry = tk.Entry(self.root)
        self.playlist_name_entry.insert(0, playlist_name)
        self.playlist_name_entry.pack()
        hr_frame = tk.Frame(self.root, bg="#1e1e2f")
        hr_frame.pack(pady=10, fill="x")

        tk.Label(hr_frame, text="❤️ Heart Rate Control", font=("Arial", 14), bg="#1e1e2f", fg="white").grid(row=0, column=0, columnspan=4, sticky="w")

        tk.Checkbutton(
            hr_frame,
            text="Enable Heart Rate Mode",
            variable=self.enable_heart_rate,
            command=self.on_toggle_heart_rate,
            bg="#1e1e2f",
            fg="white",
            selectcolor="#7d2ae8"
        ).grid(row=1, column=0, sticky="w", pady=2)

        tk.Label(hr_frame, text="Age:", bg="#1e1e2f", fg="white").grid(row=2, column=0, sticky="e")
        tk.Entry(hr_frame, width=6, textvariable=self.user_age).grid(row=2, column=1, sticky="w")

    def _create_glow_button(self, parent, text, command, color="primary", width=None):
        """Create a futuristic glowing button"""
        colors_map = {
            "primary": (COLORS['button_primary'], COLORS['bg_dark']),
            "cyan": (COLORS['accent_cyan'], COLORS['bg_dark']),
            "green": (COLORS['accent_green'], COLORS['bg_dark']),
            "teal": (COLORS['accent_teal'], COLORS['bg_dark']),
            "warning": (COLORS['warning'], COLORS['bg_dark']),
            "error": (COLORS['error'], COLORS['text_primary'])
        }
        bg, fg = colors_map.get(color, colors_map["primary"])
        
        btn = tk.Button(parent, text=text, command=command, bg=bg, fg=fg,
                       font=("Consolas", 10, "bold"), relief="flat", padx=18, pady=10,
                       activebackground=COLORS['button_hover'], activeforeground=COLORS['bg_dark'],
                       cursor="hand2", borderwidth=0)
        if width:
            btn.config(width=width)
        return btn

        card.pack(fill="both", expand=True)

            title_frame = tk.Frame(card, bg=COLORS['bg_card'])

            tk.Label(title_frame, text="━" * 40, font=("Consolas", 8),

"""
PULSE UI Components - Futuristic Heart-Themed Interface
Blue/Green Aether Color Scheme with Robotic Heart Elements
"""
import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import ttk

# PULSE Futuristic Color Scheme - Blue/Green Aether Heart Theme
PULSE_COLORS = {
    'bg_dark': '#050a0d',           # Deep dark blue-black
    'bg_card': '#0a1419',           # Dark teal card background
    'bg_input': '#0d1a1f',          # Slightly lighter input background
    'accent_cyan': '#00f0ff',       # Bright cyan (primary glow)
    'accent_green': '#00ff9d',      # Neon green (secondary glow)
    'accent_teal': '#00d4aa',       # Teal blend
    'heart_pulse': '#00ffcc',       # Heart pulse color
    'heart_glow': '#00ff88',        # Heart aura glow
    'text_primary': '#e0ffff',      # Cyan-tinted white
    'text_secondary': '#6b9999',    # Muted cyan-grey
    'text_glow': '#00ffdd',         # Glowing text
    'success': '#00ff88',           # Green success
    'warning': '#ffcc00',           # Amber warning  
    'error': '#ff4466',             # Red error
    'border': '#1a3a3a',            # Dark teal border
    'border_glow': '#00aa88',       # Glowing border
    'button_primary': '#00d4aa',    # Primary button
    'button_hover': '#00ffcc',      # Button hover
}

# Heart ASCII art for the header
PULSE_LOGO = """
💚═══════════════════════════════════════════💙
     ♥ ♡           ♥ ♡ ♥           ♡ ♥
       ╔═══════════════════════════╗
       ║    ♥  P U L S E  ♥        ║
       ╚═══════════════════════════╝
     ♡ ♥           ♥ ♡ ♥           ♥ ♡
💙═══════════════════════════════════════════💚"""


class PulseUIBuilder:
    """Helper class for building futuristic PULSE UI components"""
    
    def __init__(self, colors=None):
        self.C = colors or PULSE_COLORS
    
    def create_glow_button(self, parent, text, command, color="primary", width=None):
        """Create a futuristic glowing button"""
        colors_map = {
            "primary": (self.C['button_primary'], self.C['bg_dark']),
            "cyan": (self.C['accent_cyan'], self.C['bg_dark']),
            "green": (self.C['accent_green'], self.C['bg_dark']),
            "teal": (self.C['accent_teal'], self.C['bg_dark']),
            "warning": (self.C['warning'], self.C['bg_dark']),
            "error": (self.C['error'], self.C['text_primary'])
        }
        bg, fg = colors_map.get(color, colors_map["primary"])
        
        btn = tk.Button(parent, text=text, command=command, bg=bg, fg=fg,
                       font=("Consolas", 10, "bold"), relief="flat", padx=18, pady=10,
                       activebackground=self.C['button_hover'], 
                       activeforeground=self.C['bg_dark'], cursor="hand2", borderwidth=0)
        if width:
            btn.config(width=width)
        return btn
    
    def create_card(self, parent, title, icon="♦"):
        """Create a futuristic card with glowing border effect"""
        outer = tk.Frame(parent, bg=self.C['border_glow'], padx=2, pady=2)
        card = tk.Frame(outer, bg=self.C['bg_card'], padx=15, pady=12)
        card.pack(fill="both", expand=True)
        
        if title:
            title_frame = tk.Frame(card, bg=self.C['bg_card'])
            title_frame.pack(fill="x", pady=(0, 10))
            tk.Label(title_frame, text=f"{icon} {title}", font=("Consolas", 13, "bold"), 
                    bg=self.C['bg_card'], fg=self.C['heart_pulse']).pack(side="left")
            tk.Label(title_frame, text="━" * 35, font=("Consolas", 8), 
                    bg=self.C['bg_card'], fg=self.C['border']).pack(side="right", padx=10)
        
        return outer, card
    
    def create_slider(self, parent, label, var_list, from_, to, resolution=0.01):
        """Create futuristic styled dual slider"""
        frame = tk.Frame(parent, bg=self.C['bg_card'])
        frame.pack(fill="x", pady=8, padx=5)
        
        tk.Label(frame, text=f"💠 {label}", font=("Consolas", 10, "bold"), 
                bg=self.C['bg_card'], fg=self.C['accent_cyan'], width=16, anchor="w").pack(side="left")
        
        slider_frame = tk.Frame(frame, bg=self.C['bg_card'])
        slider_frame.pack(side="left", fill="x", expand=True)
        
        tk.Label(slider_frame, text="MIN", bg=self.C['bg_card'], fg=self.C['text_secondary'], 
                font=("Consolas", 8)).pack(side="left")
        s1 = tk.Scale(slider_frame, variable=var_list[0], from_=from_, to=to, orient="horizontal", 
                     resolution=resolution, length=130, bg=self.C['bg_input'], fg=self.C['accent_green'],
                     highlightthickness=0, troughcolor=self.C['border'], 
                     activebackground=self.C['heart_pulse'], font=("Consolas", 8))
        s1.pack(side="left", padx=5)
        
        tk.Label(slider_frame, text="MAX", bg=self.C['bg_card'], fg=self.C['text_secondary'],
                font=("Consolas", 8)).pack(side="left", padx=(10, 0))
        s2 = tk.Scale(slider_frame, variable=var_list[1], from_=from_, to=to, orient="horizontal", 
                     resolution=resolution, length=130, bg=self.C['bg_input'], fg=self.C['accent_cyan'],
                     highlightthickness=0, troughcolor=self.C['border'], 
                     activebackground=self.C['heart_pulse'], font=("Consolas", 8))
        s2.pack(side="left", padx=5)
    
    def create_entry(self, parent, width=30):
        """Create a styled entry with glow border"""
        outer = tk.Frame(parent, bg=self.C['border_glow'], padx=1, pady=1)
        entry = tk.Entry(outer, width=width, font=("Consolas", 11),
                        bg=self.C['bg_input'], fg=self.C['text_primary'],

        entry.pack(fill="x", ipady=8, padx=2, pady=2)
        return outer, entry
    
    def create_checkbox(self, parent, text, var, command=None, icon="◇"):

                           font=("Consolas", 10), selectcolor=self.C['accent_teal'],
                           activebackground=self.C['bg_card'], activeforeground=self.C['accent_cyan'])
        return cb
    
    def create_header(self, parent):
        """Create the main PULSE header with heart logo"""
        header = tk.Frame(parent, bg=self.C['bg_dark'])
        header.pack(fill="x", pady=(20, 10), padx=20)
        
        tk.Label(header, text=PULSE_LOGO, font=("Consolas", 10), 
                bg=self.C['bg_dark'], fg=self.C['heart_pulse'], justify="center").pack()
        
        tk.Label(header, text="◆ AI-POWERED MUSIC DISCOVERY ENGINE ◆", 
                font=("Consolas", 11, "bold"), bg=self.C['bg_dark'], 
                fg=self.C['accent_cyan']).pack(pady=(5, 0))
        
        tk.Label(header, text="[ Sync Your Heartbeat • Find Your Sound ]", 
                font=("Consolas", 9), bg=self.C['bg_dark'], 
                fg=self.C['text_secondary']).pack()
        
        return header
    
    def create_status_bar(self, parent, status_var):
        """Create a status bar with pulse animation feel"""
        status_outer = tk.Frame(parent, bg=self.C['border_glow'], padx=1, pady=1)
        status_outer.pack(fill="x", padx=20, pady=10)
        status_bar = tk.Frame(status_outer, bg=self.C['bg_card'], padx=15, pady=8)
        status_bar.pack(fill="x")
        
        tk.Label(status_bar, text="♥ SYSTEM STATUS:", font=("Consolas", 9, "bold"),
                bg=self.C['bg_card'], fg=self.C['heart_glow']).pack(side="left")
        tk.Label(status_bar, textvariable=status_var, font=("Consolas", 9),
                bg=self.C['bg_card'], fg=self.C['accent_green']).pack(side="left", padx=10)
        
        tk.Label(status_bar, text="♡ ♥ ♡", font=("Consolas", 10),
                bg=self.C['bg_card'], fg=self.C['accent_cyan']).pack(side="right")
        
        return status_bar
    
    def create_hr_display(self, parent, hr_var):
        """Create the heart rate display widget"""
        hr_display = tk.Frame(parent, bg=self.C['border_glow'], padx=2, pady=2)
        hr_inner = tk.Frame(hr_display, bg=self.C['bg_input'], padx=15, pady=5)
        hr_inner.pack()
        
        tk.Label(hr_inner, text="♡", font=("Consolas", 16),
                bg=self.C['bg_input'], fg=self.C['heart_glow']).pack(side="left")
        tk.Label(hr_inner, textvariable=hr_var, font=("Consolas", 20, "bold"),
                bg=self.C['bg_input'], fg=self.C['accent_green']).pack(side="left", padx=5)
        tk.Label(hr_inner, text="BPM", font=("Consolas", 10),
                bg=self.C['bg_input'], fg=self.C['text_secondary']).pack(side="left")
        
        return hr_display
    
    def create_footer(self, parent):
        """Create the footer with decorative elements"""
        footer = tk.Frame(parent, bg=self.C['bg_dark'])
        footer.pack(fill="x", pady=10)
        tk.Label(footer, text="═" * 60, 
                font=("Consolas", 8), bg=self.C['bg_dark'], fg=self.C['border']).pack()
        tk.Label(footer, text="♥ PULSE v2.0 • Powered by AI & Heart ♥", 
                font=("Consolas", 9), bg=self.C['bg_dark'], fg=self.C['text_secondary']).pack()
        tk.Label(footer, text="💚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════💙", 
                font=("Consolas", 8), bg=self.C['bg_dark'], fg=self.C['accent_teal']).pack()
        return footer

    root.minsize(900, 800)

    style = ttk.Style()
    style.theme_use('clam')

                   background=PULSE_COLORS['bg_card'],

    root.mainloop()

"""
PULSE UI Components - Futuristic Heart-Themed Interface
Blue/Green Aether Color Scheme with Robotic Heart Elements
"""
import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import ttk

# PULSE Futuristic Color Scheme - Blue/Green Aether Heart Theme
PULSE_COLORS = {
    'bg_dark': '#050a0d',           # Deep dark blue-black
    'bg_card': '#0a1419',           # Dark teal card background
    'bg_input': '#0d1a1f',          # Slightly lighter input background
    'accent_cyan': '#00f0ff',       # Bright cyan (primary glow)
    'accent_green': '#00ff9d',      # Neon green (secondary glow)
    'accent_teal': '#00d4aa',       # Teal blend
    'heart_pulse': '#00ffcc',       # Heart pulse color
    'heart_glow': '#00ff88',        # Heart aura glow
    'text_primary': '#e0ffff',      # Cyan-tinted white
    'text_secondary': '#6b9999',    # Muted cyan-grey
    'text_glow': '#00ffdd',         # Glowing text
    'success': '#00ff88',           # Green success
    'warning': '#ffcc00',           # Amber warning  
    'error': '#ff4466',             # Red error
    'border': '#1a3a3a',            # Dark teal border
    'border_glow': '#00aa88',       # Glowing border
    'button_primary': '#00d4aa',    # Primary button
    'button_hover': '#00ffcc',      # Button hover
}

# Heart ASCII art for the header
PULSE_LOGO = """
💚═══════════════════════════════════════════💙
     ♥ ♡           ♥ ♡ ♥           ♡ ♥
       ╔═══════════════════════════╗
       ║    ♥  P U L S E  ♥        ║
       ╚═══════════════════════════╝
     ♡ ♥           ♥ ♡ ♥           ♥ ♡
💙═══════════════════════════════════════════💚"""


class PulseUIBuilder:
    """Helper class for building futuristic PULSE UI components"""
    
    def __init__(self, colors=None):
        self.C = colors or PULSE_COLORS
    
    def create_glow_button(self, parent, text, command, color="primary", width=None):
        """Create a futuristic glowing button"""
        colors_map = {
            "primary": (self.C['button_primary'], self.C['bg_dark']),
            "cyan": (self.C['accent_cyan'], self.C['bg_dark']),
            "green": (self.C['accent_green'], self.C['bg_dark']),
            "teal": (self.C['accent_teal'], self.C['bg_dark']),
            "warning": (self.C['warning'], self.C['bg_dark']),
            "error": (self.C['error'], self.C['text_primary'])
        }
        bg, fg = colors_map.get(color, colors_map["primary"])
        
        btn = tk.Button(parent, text=text, command=command, bg=bg, fg=fg,
                       font=("Consolas", 10, "bold"), relief="flat", padx=18, pady=10,
                       activebackground=self.C['button_hover'], 
                       activeforeground=self.C['bg_dark'], cursor="hand2", borderwidth=0)
        if width:
            btn.config(width=width)
        return btn
    
    def create_card(self, parent, title, icon="♦"):
        """Create a futuristic card with glowing border effect"""
        outer = tk.Frame(parent, bg=self.C['border_glow'], padx=2, pady=2)
        card = tk.Frame(outer, bg=self.C['bg_card'], padx=15, pady=12)
        card.pack(fill="both", expand=True)
        
        if title:
            title_frame = tk.Frame(card, bg=self.C['bg_card'])
            title_frame.pack(fill="x", pady=(0, 10))
            tk.Label(title_frame, text=f"{icon} {title}", font=("Consolas", 13, "bold"), 
                    bg=self.C['bg_card'], fg=self.C['heart_pulse']).pack(side="left")
            tk.Label(title_frame, text="━" * 35, font=("Consolas", 8), 
                    bg=self.C['bg_card'], fg=self.C['border']).pack(side="right", padx=10)
        
        return outer, card
    
    def create_slider(self, parent, label, var_list, from_, to, resolution=0.01):
        """Create futuristic styled dual slider"""
        frame = tk.Frame(parent, bg=self.C['bg_card'])
        frame.pack(fill="x", pady=8, padx=5)
        
        tk.Label(frame, text=f"💠 {label}", font=("Consolas", 10, "bold"), 
                bg=self.C['bg_card'], fg=self.C['accent_cyan'], width=16, anchor="w").pack(side="left")
        
        slider_frame = tk.Frame(frame, bg=self.C['bg_card'])
        slider_frame.pack(side="left", fill="x", expand=True)
        
        tk.Label(slider_frame, text="MIN", bg=self.C['bg_card'], fg=self.C['text_secondary'], 
                font=("Consolas", 8)).pack(side="left")
        s1 = tk.Scale(slider_frame, variable=var_list[0], from_=from_, to=to, orient="horizontal", 
                     resolution=resolution, length=130, bg=self.C['bg_input'], fg=self.C['accent_green'],
                     highlightthickness=0, troughcolor=self.C['border'], 
                     activebackground=self.C['heart_pulse'], font=("Consolas", 8))
        s1.pack(side="left", padx=5)
        
        tk.Label(slider_frame, text="MAX", bg=self.C['bg_card'], fg=self.C['text_secondary'],
                font=("Consolas", 8)).pack(side="left", padx=(10, 0))
        s2 = tk.Scale(slider_frame, variable=var_list[1], from_=from_, to=to, orient="horizontal", 
                     resolution=resolution, length=130, bg=self.C['bg_input'], fg=self.C['accent_cyan'],
                     highlightthickness=0, troughcolor=self.C['border'], 
                     activebackground=self.C['heart_pulse'], font=("Consolas", 8))
        s2.pack(side="left", padx=5)
    
    def create_entry(self, parent, width=30):
        """Create a styled entry with glow border"""
        outer = tk.Frame(parent, bg=self.C['border_glow'], padx=1, pady=1)
        entry = tk.Entry(outer, width=width, font=("Consolas", 11),
                        bg=self.C['bg_input'], fg=self.C['text_primary'],
                        insertbackground=self.C['accent_cyan'], relief="flat")
        entry.pack(fill="x", ipady=8, padx=2, pady=2)
        return outer, entry
    
    def create_checkbox(self, parent, text, var, command=None, icon="◇"):
        """Create a styled checkbox"""
        cb = tk.Checkbutton(parent, text=f"{icon} {text}", variable=var,
                           command=command, bg=self.C['bg_card'], fg=self.C['text_primary'],
                           font=("Consolas", 10), selectcolor=self.C['accent_teal'],
                           activebackground=self.C['bg_card'], activeforeground=self.C['accent_cyan'])
        return cb
    
    def create_header(self, parent):
        """Create the main PULSE header with heart logo"""
        header = tk.Frame(parent, bg=self.C['bg_dark'])
        header.pack(fill="x", pady=(20, 10), padx=20)
        
        tk.Label(header, text=PULSE_LOGO, font=("Consolas", 10), 
                bg=self.C['bg_dark'], fg=self.C['heart_pulse'], justify="center").pack()
        
        tk.Label(header, text="◆ AI-POWERED MUSIC DISCOVERY ENGINE ◆", 
                font=("Consolas", 11, "bold"), bg=self.C['bg_dark'], 
                fg=self.C['accent_cyan']).pack(pady=(5, 0))
        
        tk.Label(header, text="[ Sync Your Heartbeat • Find Your Sound ]", 
                font=("Consolas", 9), bg=self.C['bg_dark'], 
                fg=self.C['text_secondary']).pack()
        
        return header
    
    def create_status_bar(self, parent, status_var):
        """Create a status bar with pulse animation feel"""
        status_outer = tk.Frame(parent, bg=self.C['border_glow'], padx=1, pady=1)
        status_outer.pack(fill="x", padx=20, pady=10)
        status_bar = tk.Frame(status_outer, bg=self.C['bg_card'], padx=15, pady=8)
        status_bar.pack(fill="x")
        
        tk.Label(status_bar, text="♥ SYSTEM STATUS:", font=("Consolas", 9, "bold"),
                bg=self.C['bg_card'], fg=self.C['heart_glow']).pack(side="left")
        tk.Label(status_bar, textvariable=status_var, font=("Consolas", 9),
                bg=self.C['bg_card'], fg=self.C['accent_green']).pack(side="left", padx=10)
        
        tk.Label(status_bar, text="♡ ♥ ♡", font=("Consolas", 10),
                bg=self.C['bg_card'], fg=self.C['accent_cyan']).pack(side="right")
        
        return status_bar
    
    def create_hr_display(self, parent, hr_var):
        """Create the heart rate display widget"""
        hr_display = tk.Frame(parent, bg=self.C['border_glow'], padx=2, pady=2)
        hr_inner = tk.Frame(hr_display, bg=self.C['bg_input'], padx=15, pady=5)
        hr_inner.pack()
        
        tk.Label(hr_inner, text="♡", font=("Consolas", 16),
                bg=self.C['bg_input'], fg=self.C['heart_glow']).pack(side="left")
        tk.Label(hr_inner, textvariable=hr_var, font=("Consolas", 20, "bold"),
                bg=self.C['bg_input'], fg=self.C['accent_green']).pack(side="left", padx=5)
        tk.Label(hr_inner, text="BPM", font=("Consolas", 10),
                bg=self.C['bg_input'], fg=self.C['text_secondary']).pack(side="left")
        
        return hr_display
    
    def create_footer(self, parent):
        """Create the footer with decorative elements"""
        footer = tk.Frame(parent, bg=self.C['bg_dark'])
        footer.pack(fill="x", pady=10)
        tk.Label(footer, text="═" * 60, 
                font=("Consolas", 8), bg=self.C['bg_dark'], fg=self.C['border']).pack()
        tk.Label(footer, text="♥ PULSE v2.0 • Powered by AI & Heart ♥", 
                font=("Consolas", 9), bg=self.C['bg_dark'], fg=self.C['text_secondary']).pack()
        tk.Label(footer, text="💚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════💙", 
                font=("Consolas", 8), bg=self.C['bg_dark'], fg=self.C['accent_teal']).pack()
        return footer


def apply_pulse_theme(root):
    """Apply the PULSE theme to a root window"""
    root.title("💚 PULSE 💙 AI Music Engine")
    root.geometry("950x900")
    root.configure(bg=PULSE_COLORS['bg_dark'])
    root.minsize(900, 800)
    
    # Configure ttk styles for scrollbar
    style = ttk.Style()
    style.theme_use('clam')
    style.configure("Vertical.TScrollbar",
                   background=PULSE_COLORS['bg_card'],
                   troughcolor=PULSE_COLORS['bg_dark'],
                   arrowcolor=PULSE_COLORS['accent_cyan'])


if __name__ == "__main__":

    canvas.configure(yscrollcommand=scrollbar.set)
    
    scrollbar.pack(side="right", fill="y")
    canvas.pack(side="left", fill="both", expand=True)
    
    # Demo components

    outer.pack(fill="x", padx=20, pady=10)
    
    tk.Label(card, text="This is a demo of the PULSE UI", 
            font=("Consolas", 11), bg=PULSE_COLORS['bg_card'], 
            fg=PULSE_COLORS['text_primary']).pack(pady=10)
    
    ui.create_glow_button(card, "💚 TEST BUTTON 💙", lambda: print("Clicked!"), "cyan").pack(pady=10)
    
    ui.create_footer(frame)
    
    root.mainloop()

"""
PULSE GUI Builder - Creates the futuristic heart-themed interface
Import this and call build_pulse_gui(app) where app is the PulseGUI instance
"""
import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import ttk
from PulseUI import PulseUIBuilder, PULSE_COLORS, PULSE_LOGO


def build_pulse_gui(app):
    """
    Build the complete PULSE GUI with futuristic heart theme.
    
    Args:
        app: The PulseGUI (or HeavenRaveGUI) instance
    """
    C = PULSE_COLORS
    ui = PulseUIBuilder(C)
    app.genre_checkbuttons = {}
    
    # Create scrollable main container
    main_canvas = tk.Canvas(app.root, bg=C['bg_dark'], highlightthickness=0)
    scrollbar = ttk.Scrollbar(app.root, orient="vertical", command=main_canvas.yview)
    scrollable_frame = tk.Frame(main_canvas, bg=C['bg_dark'])
    
    scrollable_frame.bind("<Configure>", 
        lambda e: main_canvas.configure(scrollregion=main_canvas.bbox("all")))
    main_canvas.create_window((0, 0), window=scrollable_frame, anchor="nw")
    main_canvas.configure(yscrollcommand=scrollbar.set)
    main_canvas.bind_all("<MouseWheel>", lambda e: main_canvas.yview_scroll(int(-1*(e.delta/120)), "units"))
    
    scrollbar.pack(side="right", fill="y")
    main_canvas.pack(side="left", fill="both", expand=True)
    
    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    # HEADER - Futuristic Heart Logo
    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    ui.create_header(scrollable_frame)
    ui.create_status_bar(scrollable_frame, app.status_text)
    
    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    # AI SEARCH CARD
    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    ai_outer, ai_card = ui.create_card(scrollable_frame, "AI MUSIC SEARCH", "🔮")
    ai_outer.pack(fill="x", padx=20, pady=10)
    
    search_frame = tk.Frame(ai_card, bg=C['bg_card'])
    search_frame.pack(fill="x", pady=8)
    
    entry_outer, app.ai_search_entry = ui.create_entry(search_frame, 45)
    entry_outer.pack(side="left", fill="x", expand=True, padx=(0, 10))
    app.ai_search_entry.insert(0, "⌨ 'energetic EDM' or 'chill study beats'...")
    app.ai_search_entry.bind("<FocusIn>", lambda e: app.ai_search_entry.delete(0, tk.END) 
                              if "⌨" in app.ai_search_entry.get() else None)
    
    ui.create_glow_button(search_frame, "🔍 SEARCH", app.ai_search_playlist, "green").pack(side="left")
    
    # Search type selection
    type_frame = tk.Frame(ai_card, bg=C['bg_card'])
    type_frame.pack(fill="x", pady=10)
    tk.Label(type_frame, text="◇ MODE:", font=("Consolas", 9, "bold"),
            bg=C['bg_card'], fg=C['text_secondary']).pack(side="left")
    
    app.search_type = tk.StringVar(value="smart")
    for text, value, icon in [("Smart AI", "smart", "🧠"), ("Lyrics", "lyrics", "🎤"), ("Playlists", "playlists", "📋")]:
        tk.Radiobutton(type_frame, text=f"{icon} {text}", variable=app.search_type, value=value,
                      bg=C['bg_card'], fg=C['text_primary'], font=("Consolas", 10),
                      selectcolor=C['accent_teal'], activebackground=C['bg_card'],
                      indicatoron=0, padx=12, pady=5, relief="flat").pack(side="left", padx=6)
    
    # Result display
    result_outer = tk.Frame(ai_card, bg=C['border'], padx=1, pady=1)
    result_outer.pack(fill="x", pady=10)
    app.ai_result_text = tk.StringVar(value="♫ Awaiting your musical desires... ♫")
    tk.Label(result_outer, textvariable=app.ai_result_text, bg=C['bg_input'],
            fg=C['text_secondary'], wraplength=750, justify="left",
            font=("Consolas", 10), padx=15, pady=12).pack(fill="x")

    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    # GENRE SELECTION CARD
    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    genre_outer, genre_card = ui.create_card(scrollable_frame, "GENRE MATRIX", "🎵")
    genre_outer.pack(fill="x", padx=20, pady=10)
    
    genre_actions = tk.Frame(genre_card, bg=C['bg_card'])
    genre_actions.pack(fill="x", pady=(0, 12))
    ui.create_glow_button(genre_actions, "◉ ALL", app.select_all_genres, "teal").pack(side="left", padx=3)
    ui.create_glow_button(genre_actions, "◎ NONE", app.deselect_all_genres, "warning").pack(side="left", padx=3)
    ui.create_glow_button(genre_actions, "🔍 SEARCH GENRES", app.search_by_selected_genres, "cyan").pack(side="right", padx=3)
    
    genre_grid = tk.Frame(genre_card, bg=C['bg_card'])
    genre_grid.pack(fill="x")
    
    for i, genre in enumerate(app.available_genres):
        row, col = divmod(i, 4)
        btn = tk.Checkbutton(genre_grid, text=f"♦ {genre.title()}", variable=app.selected_genres[genre],
                            bg=C['bg_card'], fg=C['text_primary'], font=("Consolas", 10),
                            selectcolor=C['accent_teal'], activebackground=C['bg_card'],
                            command=lambda g=genre: app.genre_clicked(g), width=14, anchor="w")
        btn.grid(row=row, column=col, sticky="w", padx=8, pady=4)
        app.genre_checkbuttons[genre] = btn

    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    # AUDIO FEATURES CARD
    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    audio_outer, audio_card = ui.create_card(scrollable_frame, "AUDIO PARAMETERS", "🎚")
    audio_outer.pack(fill="x", padx=20, pady=10)
    
    ui.create_slider(audio_card, "ENERGY", app.energy_range, 0.0, 1.0)
    ui.create_slider(audio_card, "MOOD", app.valence_range, 0.0, 1.0)
    ui.create_slider(audio_card, "TEMPO BPM", app.tempo_range, 60, 200, resolution=1)

    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    # PLAYLIST OPTIONS CARD
    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    options_outer, options_card = ui.create_card(scrollable_frame, "OUTPUT CONFIG", "⚙")
    options_outer.pack(fill="x", padx=20, pady=10)
    
    name_frame = tk.Frame(options_card, bg=C['bg_card'])
    name_frame.pack(fill="x", pady=8)
    tk.Label(name_frame, text="💿 PLAYLIST NAME:", font=("Consolas", 10, "bold"), 
            bg=C['bg_card'], fg=C['accent_cyan']).pack(side="left")
    
    name_entry_outer, app.playlist_name_entry = ui.create_entry(name_frame, 25)
    name_entry_outer.pack(side="left", padx=10)
    default_name = "PULSE Mix"
    playlist_name = app.config.get("playlist_name", default_name) if app.config else default_name
    app.playlist_name_entry.insert(0, playlist_name)
    
    # Options checkboxes grid
    checkbox_grid = tk.Frame(options_card, bg=C['bg_card'])
    checkbox_grid.pack(fill="x", pady=10)
    
    checkboxes = [
        ("Recommendations", app.include_recommendations, 0, 0, "💡"),
        ("Liked Songs", app.include_liked, 0, 1, "❤"),
        ("Recent Plays", app.include_recent, 1, 0, "🕐"),
        ("Make Public", app.make_public, 1, 1, "🌐"),
        ("Weekly Refresh", app.enable_refresh, 2, 0, "🔄"),
    ]
    
    for text, var, row, col, icon in checkboxes:
        cb = ui.create_checkbox(checkbox_grid, text, var, lambda t=text, v=var: app._option_clicked(t, v), icon)
        cb.grid(row=row, column=col, sticky="w", padx=12, pady=5)

    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    # HEART RATE INTEGRATION CARD
    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    hr_outer, hr_card = ui.create_card(scrollable_frame, "BIOMETRIC SYNC", "💚")
    hr_outer.pack(fill="x", padx=20, pady=10)
    
    hr_toggle_frame = tk.Frame(hr_card, bg=C['bg_card'])
    hr_toggle_frame.pack(fill="x", pady=5)
    
    tk.Checkbutton(hr_toggle_frame, text="♥ ENABLE HEART RATE MODE ♥", 
                   variable=app.enable_heart_rate, command=app.on_toggle_heart_rate,
                   bg=C['bg_card'], fg=C['heart_pulse'],
                   font=("Consolas", 11, "bold"), selectcolor=C['accent_green']).pack(side="left")
    
    hr_display = ui.create_hr_display(hr_toggle_frame, app.current_hr)
    hr_display.pack(side="right")
    
    # HR settings
    hr_settings = tk.Frame(hr_card, bg=C['bg_card'])
    hr_settings.pack(fill="x", pady=10)
    
    for i, (label, var, width) in enumerate([("Age:", app.user_age, 5), 
                                              ("Resting HR:", app.resting_hr, 5),
                                              ("BLE Device:", app.hr_device, 18)]):
        tk.Label(hr_settings, text=label, bg=C['bg_card'], fg=C['text_secondary'],
                font=("Consolas", 9)).grid(row=0, column=i*2, padx=5)
        entry = tk.Entry(hr_settings, textvariable=var, width=width, bg=C['bg_input'],
                fg=C['text_primary'], font=("Consolas", 10), insertbackground=C['accent_cyan'])
        entry.grid(row=0, column=i*2+1, padx=5)
    
    hr_buttons = tk.Frame(hr_card, bg=C['bg_card'])
    hr_buttons.pack(fill="x", pady=8)
    ui.create_glow_button(hr_buttons, "▶ START HR", app.start_heart_rate, "green").pack(side="left", padx=5)
    ui.create_glow_button(hr_buttons, "■ STOP HR", app.stop_heart_rate, "error").pack(side="left", padx=5)

    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    # MAIN ACTION BUTTONS
    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    action_frame = tk.Frame(scrollable_frame, bg=C['bg_dark'])
    action_frame.pack(fill="x", padx=20, pady=20)
    
    generate_btn = tk.Button(action_frame, text="💚 GENERATE PLAYLIST 💙", 
                            command=app.summon_playlist,
                            bg=C['accent_green'], fg=C['bg_dark'],
                            font=("Consolas", 14, "bold"), relief="flat", 
                            padx=40, pady=15, cursor="hand2",
                            activebackground=C['heart_pulse'])
    generate_btn.pack(side="left", padx=10)
    
    ui.create_glow_button(action_frame, "🔄 CLEAR CACHE", app.clear_spotify_cache, "warning").pack(side="left", padx=10)
    
    # Debug section (minimal)
    debug_outer = tk.Frame(scrollable_frame, bg=C['border'], padx=1, pady=1)
    debug_outer.pack(fill="x", padx=20, pady=(0, 10))
    debug_frame = tk.Frame(debug_outer, bg=C['bg_card'], padx=10, pady=8)
    debug_frame.pack(fill="x")
    
    tk.Label(debug_frame, text="🔧 DEBUG:", font=("Consolas", 9), 
            bg=C['bg_card'], fg=C['text_secondary']).pack(side="left")
    app.debug_track_entry = tk.Entry(debug_frame, width=25, font=("Consolas", 9),
                                     bg=C['bg_input'], fg=C['text_primary'])
    app.debug_track_entry.pack(side="left", padx=8)
    tk.Button(debug_frame, text="Test Match", command=app.test_genre_match,
             bg=C['border'], fg=C['text_secondary'], font=("Consolas", 8),
             relief="flat").pack(side="left")
    
    # Footer
    ui.create_footer(scrollable_frame)
